gap: No result ChatGPT got states that Tenergy's own store sells the TN480U 8-bay charger with 8 Premium Pro 2,800 mAh AA as one bundle (P/N 90732) for $42.99, which is $2.99 less than buying the two separately ($45.98), or that the bundle's charger runs only from USB and comes without a wall adapter: you need a 5 V / 2 A USB plug you already own, because Tenergy's store sells no adapter to add to the same cart.
standout_why: I compared against GeekChamp's 'Best Rechargeable Batteries for AA and AAA Devices in 2026' (cited) and IKEA's STENKOL/LADDA page (cited). GeekChamp names Amazon Basics, BEVIGOR, Granicell, RayHom and Brightown bundles, says 'The battery and charger are one system' and warns against putting lithium cells in NiMH-only chargers. It never mentions Tenergy, a maker-store bundle price against buying separately, or a charger that needs your own USB power adapter. IKEA's STENKOL is a mains charger and its page only covers NiMH capacity limits. I couldn't compare against two more rivals. The Consumer Library (cited) wouldn't load because of an SSL certificate error. Digital Camera World's AA guide (cited) came back with only its title. Neither of ChatGPT's answers raised the missing adapter or the bundle saving. The finding is useful and new against the pages I could read, but it doesn't decide the set on its own, so I scored it 2.
kit_items: Charger: Tenergy TN480U 8-bay NiMH charger. It is an approved CJ program (cj:tenergy) and already listed on Dealectric. Its product page says it charges '1-8 AA/AAA NiMH without pairs' and stops by negative delta V. It puts 500 mA into each AA slot and 250 mA into each AAA slot, from a 5 V / 2 A input through Micro-USB or USB-C.
Batteries: Tenergy Premium PRO AA 2,800 mAh NiMH, 8 cells. They are sold in the same bundle SKU as the charger, are rated for 1,200 cycles and come pre-charged.

Power: a 5 V / 2 A (10 W or more) USB wall adapter. The bundle page says 'Micro-USB to AC power adapter is NOT included'. A search of Tenergy's store for 'premium pro AA' showed no adapter, so it can't go in the same cart. The shopper uses a phone charger they already own.

Other Tenergy combos: TN480U + 8 AA + 8 AAA (P/N 91257) $47.99; TN480U + 8 × 2500 mAh AA (P/N 90753) $34.99; TN480U + 4 AA 2500 + 4 AAA 1000 (P/N 90754) $32.49. There's no free gift. The product page shows 'Free Shipping'. The site banner offers free ground shipping over $50 with code THANKS.
